title: 🖐️ Retro Player / Generated Hand Atlas

current_candidate.summary: V8 fixes the no-hand V7 regression: it uses the real corrected 1280x1280 generated atlas as five 128px-cell row strips, removes dark source backgrounds into alpha at load time, and renders with normal source-over compositing.

open_feedback: Verify in the real published Player that the hand is now visibly present from IDLE without any interaction.
Judge whether the 125ms idle cadence and 90ms action cadence feel like coherent stop-motion rather than flicker.
Tune foreground scale/position only after confirming visibility; preserve the complete generated hand identity.
If runtime dark-background keying erodes important dark finger/shadow detail, replace it with authored alpha assets rather than returning to screen compositing.
Only activate the remaining planned atlas actions after the core hand is visually convincing.
